# Nytcrew

> Nytcrew (formerly Sifty) is a free Android app that cleans up your photo gallery overnight. An AI model running on the phone (MiniCPM-V) describes each photo; only a short masked text description is sent to be scored, never the image. It flags old screenshots and other screen content, blurry or accidental shots and repeats for a quick keep-or-delete review, groups similar shots, makes photos searchable by content and text, and learns from the user's choices.

Key facts:
- Platform: Android, 6 GB RAM or more. Not on iOS (the App Store has the earlier, cloud-based Sifty app).
- Price: free, no ads, no subscription.
- Privacy: photos never leave the phone. A short description, up to 25 words of visible text and the photo's age (emails, links, @handles, long numbers masked) are scored by Google's Gemini via Nytcrew's server. Results, learned preferences and speed statistics are backed up to the user's account.
- Model: one-time download of about 1.3 GB.
- Safety: never deletes on its own; deleted photos stay in Android's trash for 30 days.
- Maker: M. Junaid, independent developer, India.
